quotes.text: It actually has its own dance too, known as skanking.
When you're skanking, you need to be dressed appropriately.
The first step to skanking is bobbing of your arms.
After that though, you're going to start kicking, which is the last step.
Warning, be sure not to ever skank with scissors!
